$comment: Split by section. Each entry under properties that is a $ref points at a file in schemas/settings/. The root schema deliberately carries no $id so that every relative $ref resolves against wherever this file actually sits — the checkout for the editor, the deployed origin over HTTP. Shared value types live in schemas/settings/common.schema.json. github stays inline: it is the one section every portfolio must set before anything else works.
title: Portfolio Website Configuration Schema
description:
Comprehensive JSON Schema for portfolio website configuration including GitHub integration, project management, social media, resume sections, and UI customization. This schema provides validation, IntelliSense support, and documentation for all configuration options.

=== NEW FEATURES ===

MODULAR COLOR SYSTEM:
The portfolio now supports ANY valid CSS color format throughout all configuration options:
- Hex: #a855f7, #a855f780 (with alpha)
- RGB/RGBA: rgb(168, 85, 247), rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5)
- HSL/HSLA: hsl(270, 91%, 65%), hsla(270, 91%, 65%, 0.8)
- Named Colors: purple, blue, red, white, black, etc.
- Tailwind Classes: purple-500, blue-400 (auto-converted to hex)
- CSS Variables: var(--primary-color)
- Gradients: linear-gradient(to right, #c770f0, #ec4899)

EXAMPLES:
  "borderColor": "#a855f7"  // Hex color
  "textColor": "rgb(192, 132, 252)"  // RGB color
  "hoverBg": "rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5)"  // RGBA with opacity
  "shadowColor": "hsla(270, 91%, 65%, 0.3)"  // HSLA color
  "gradient": "linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea, #764ba2)"  // Gradient

See: docs/Color System Guide.md for complete documentation

UNIFIED ICON SYSTEM:
Use ANY icon from react-icons (40+ icon libraries, 50,000+ icons) anywhere in settings.json:
- FontAwesome: FaReact, FaHome, FaGithub, FaHeart, FaStar
- Material Design: MdHome, MdSettings, MdPerson, MdFavorite
- Heroicons: HiHome, HiUser, HiCog, HiHeart
- Simple Icons: SiReact, SiJavascript, SiPython, SiGithub
- Bootstrap Icons: BsHouse, BsPerson, BsGear
- Ionicons: IoHome, IoPerson, IoSettings
- Lucide: LuHome, LuUser, LuSettings
- And 35+ more libraries!

EXAMPLES:
  "icon": "FaReact"  // FontAwesome React icon
  "icon": "MdHome"   // Material Design home icon
  "icon": "HiUser"   // Heroicons user icon
  "icon": "SiGithub" // Simple Icons GitHub logo

Browse all available icons: https://react-icons.github.io/react-icons

ICON NAMING CONVENTION:
- Prefix indicates library: Fa (FontAwesome), Md (Material), Hi (Heroicons), Si (Simple Icons)
- Follow with descriptive name: React, Home, User, Settings, GitHub
- Examples: FaReact, MdHome, HiUser, SiGithub, BsHouse, IoSettings

SUPPORTED ICON LIBRARIES (40+):
  Ai  - Ant Design Icons       | Bs  - Bootstrap Icons
  Bi  - Boxicons              | Ci  - Circum Icons
  Di  - Devicons              | Fi  - Feather
  Fc  - Flat Color Icons      | Fa  - Font Awesome
  Fa6 - Font Awesome 6        | Gi  - Game Icons
  Go  - GitHub Octicons       | Gr  - Grommet Icons
  Hi  - Heroicons (v1)        | Hi2 - Heroicons 2
  Im  - IcoMoon Free          | Io  - Ionicons 4
  Io5 - Ionicons 5            | Lu  - Lucide
  Md  - Material Design       | Pi  - Phosphor Icons
  Ri  - Remix Icon            | Rx  - Radix Icons
  Si  - Simple Icons          | Sl  - Simple Line Icons
  Tb  - Tabler Icons          | Tfi - Themify Icons
  Ti  - Typicons              | Vsc - VS Code Icons
  Wi  - Weather Icons         | Cg  - css.gg

LEGACY COMPATIBILITY:
Old Tailwind class formats (e.g., "border-purple-500", "text-blue-400") still work for backward compatibility but are deprecated. New configurations should use CSS color values.

=== ORIGINAL FEATURES ===

- Dynamic GitHub project fetching with fallback to static projects
- Comprehensive social media integration
- Resume/CV management with multiple sections
- Customizable UI themes and animations
- SEO-optimized project metadata
- Mobile-responsive configuration options
- Accessibility features and validation

BEST PRACTICES:
- Use semantic technology tags (lowercase kebab-case)
- Include comprehensive project descriptions (50+ characters)
- Provide multiple project URLs (live, demo, documentation)
- Maintain consistent color schemes across social platforms
- Optimize images for web (prefer CDN URLs)
- Include accessibility labels for all interactive elements
- Use the unified icon system for all icon references
- Prefer CSS color values over Tailwind classes for better flexibility

TECHNOLOGY RECOMMENDATIONS:
- Frontend: React, Vue.js, Angular, Svelte
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, CSS Modules
- Backend: Node.js, Python, Java, Go, Rust
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase
- Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, Vercel, Netlify
- DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, CI/CD

github.description:
GitHub API configuration for dynamic repository fetching. This enables automatic project discovery and keeps your portfolio synchronized with your latest work.

SETUP GUIDE:
1. Choose 'org' for organization repos or 'user' for personal repos
2. Set username to your GitHub username or organization name
3. Construct apiUrl: https://api.github.com/{orgs|users}/{username}/repos
4. Use descriptive userAgent for API identification

RATE LIMITS:
- Unauthenticated: 60 requests/hour
- Authenticated: 5000 requests/hour
- Consider caching for production use

type.description:
GitHub account type:
- 'org': Organization account (e.g., company, team, project group)
- 'user': Individual user account (personal repositories)

This affects the API endpoint structure and available repository types.

username.description:
GitHub username or organization name. Must follow GitHub naming conventions:
- 1-39 characters long
- Alphanumeric characters and hyphens only
- Cannot start or end with hyphen
- Cannot contain consecutive hyphens

apiUrl.description:
GitHub API endpoint for fetching repositories. Must be a valid GitHub API URL:
- For organizations: https://api.github.com/orgs/{org-name}/repos
- For users: https://api.github.com/users/{username}/repos

Ensure the URL matches your account type and username.

userAgent.description:
Custom user agent string for API requests. This helps with:
- API rate limiting and identification
- Analytics and usage tracking
- Debugging and monitoring

Use a descriptive name that identifies your portfolio site.

accessToken.description:
Optional GitHub Personal Access Token for higher rate limits and private repository access. Format: ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxx

Security: Store in Environment Variables, not in committed code!

cacheTimeout.description: Cache timeout for API responses in seconds (5 minutes to 24 hours). Helps with rate limiting and performance.
